full_judgment: 6. The learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the appellants among others submits that the learned Court below during passing the impugned judgment and order committed illegality resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice. The learned Advocate further submits that the learned Court below failed to apply his judicial mind in appreciation of actual facts of the case that the present appellants as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.439 of 2010 in the 2nd Court of learned Joint District Judge, Dhaka and while the learned Court below by his judgment and decree dated 10.08.2015 dismissed the suit on the ground of maintainability, the appellants being aggrieved of that preferred First Appeal No.245 of 2015 before this Court which is now pending for disposal. The learned Advocate further submits that during pendency of the appeal his Lordships Mr. Justice Nazrul Islam Chowdhury and Mr. Justice Mohammad Ullah passed an order of status quo for three months in respect of  possession and position of the suit land vide order dated 11.03.2013 but the learned Advocate for the appellants erroneously had an idea that the order of status quo has been granted till disposal of the appeal and as a result of which he could not take any step for extension of that order of status quo and meanwhile the appellant Kosimonnessa died on 19.06.2014 and on an application her name was deleted vide order dated 15.11.2015. The learned Advocate frankly conceded that due to his inadvertent mistake the order of status quo granted earlier was not extended. The learned Advocate prays for an order of status quo in respect of possession and position of the disputed property till disposal of the suit.
